Closing time draws near, but the next couple of days already have some beautiful invitations waiting.

Wednesday, August 5

• Tina’s Tarot & Rune Sessions
  12:00 PM–6:00 PM

• Soul Alignment w/ Karen: Intuitive Energy Reiki or Akashic Record Reading
  7:00 PM–10:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/karen/

Thursday, August 6

• Tarot with Adie
  12:00 PM–5:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/adie/

• Tai Chi Gung with Sherry Gurley
  12:00 PM–1:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/sherry/

• Quantum Alignment Series- Light Codes, Sound Frequencies & Light Language With Eve
  7:00 PM–9:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/eve-quantum-class/

Friday, August 7

• The Reflexology Reset: Restorative Wellness w/ Cheryl
  11:00 AM–3:00 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/cheryl-2/

• Keeper of the Cards: Robert
  1:00 PM–6:30 PM
  https://shopsacredground.com/book/robert/

Before you turn in — if the evening still has a little room in it…
Visit the Observatory. It changes every day.
https://shopsacredground.com/sacred-ground-observatory/

Or wander the Library for a meditation, a playlist, or something gentle to watch or hear.
https://shopsacredground.com/library/

Call to book a session or grab your spot online.
847-749-3922
https://shopsacredground.com/events/

The door is always open...we will leave the light on
